in_marathi.name: Naksh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sky, star, or mark
in_marathi.long_meaning: Naksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nakshatra', meaning 'star'. In Hindu astrology, each of the 27 constellations is associated with a 'nakshatra'. The name Naksh signifies the cosmic influence of the stars and the divine power of the universe.
